home.title: Parent Reset – Make today easier
home.description: A simple reset for parents carrying too much in their head. Sort what matters today, what can wait, and what you can let go.

reset.title: Start my reset – Parent Reset
reset.description: A two-minute check-in that turns a full head into a short list for today.

result.title: Your reset – Parent Reset
result.description: Your short list for today, what can wait until this week, and what you can let go.

load.description: A simple view of what is taking up space in your head: kids, money, home, work, relationship and you.

account.title: Your account – Parent Reset
account.description: Sign in to keep your resets and family load across devices.

history.title: Your history – Parent Reset
history.description: Previous resets and whether days have been getting lighter.

community.title: Community – Parent Reset
community.description: A small, anonymous-first place for parents to say the quiet part out loud.

pause.title: Breathe for a minute – Parent Reset
pause.description: A guided minute of breathing. No typing, no decisions, and it works with a child on your hip.

evening.title: Close the day – Parent Reset
evening.description: One hard thing, one thing worth keeping, one thing for tomorrow.

kept.description: The moments you decided were worth keeping, handed back to you weeks later.

hero.eyebrow: For parents with too much in their head
hero.title: Life is a lot. Let's make today easier.
hero.subtitle: A simple reset for parents carrying too much in their head.
hero.trust: No account needed. About two minutes. Nothing is shared.

steps.title: How it works
steps.subtitle: Three short steps. No apps to set up, no habits to build.

one.title: Tell us what's weighing on you
one.body: How full today feels, what's taking the most space, and how much time you really have.

two.title: Sort what matters
two.body: We split it into what has to happen today, what can wait, and what can wait a lot.

three.title: Make today smaller
three.body: You leave with a short list you can actually finish. That's the whole point.

buckets.title: What you get
buckets.subtitle: One page. Three lists. No dashboards.

today.label: Today
today.body: Up to three things that truly matter today. Not everything, just enough.

thisWeek.label: This week
thisWeek.body: Things that count but do not need to be solved before bedtime.

letGo.label: Let it go
letGo.body: Permission to leave the rest alone for now. It will still be there tomorrow.

items.notTherapy: This is not therapy or medical advice. It is a way to sort a busy day.
items.private: Your answers stay on your device unless you create an account and choose to save them.
items.languages: Available in your language, on your phone, one-handed.

finalCta.title: Ready when you are.
finalCta.body: Two minutes now can make the rest of the day feel lighter.

reset.title: Parent Reset

hint.oneHand: Answer honestly. There are no wrong answers and nothing is scored.

overwhelmed.title: How overwhelmed do you feel today?
overwhelmed.help: 1 is calm, 10 is completely maxed out.

areas.title: What is taking the most mental space?

time.title: How much usable time do you realistically have today?
time.help: Time that is actually yours, not time you are supposed to have.

money.title: Is money pressure part of today's stress?
money.help: This only changes how we sort your list.

must.title: What absolutely needs to happen today?
must.help: One thing per line is easiest. Keep it to what really cannot wait.
must.placeholder:
Pay the electricity bill
Pick up the kids at 4
Call the dentist

onMind.title: What else is on your mind?
onMind.help: Anything at all. You can leave this empty.
onMind.placeholder: Feeling behind on everything at work. Still haven't sorted the birthday.

today.label: Today
today.intro: Only these. If you finish them, the day counted.
today.allDone: All done. That was the day.
today.focus: Do them one at a time

thisWeek.label: This week
thisWeek.intro: Matters, but does not need solving today.

notFound.body: It may have been created on another device or cleared from this browser.

result.disclaimer: Parent Reset is a practical planning tool, not medical or therapeutic advice.

summary.calm: Today feels manageable. Let's keep it that way with a short list.
summary.busy: You have a fair amount competing for your attention today. Here is what to keep, what can wait, and what to leave alone.
summary.heavy: You have a lot competing for your attention today. Today's list is small on purpose.

time.under30: You have less than 30 minutes that are really yours, so today's list is very short.
time.30to60: With about half an hour to an hour, three things is the realistic ceiling.
time.1to2h: You have one to two hours, enough for a few things done well.
time.over2h: You have some real time today. Use it for what matters, not for everything.

today.moneyCheck: Check which payment is actually due first. Handle that one only.
today.pickOne: Pick the one thing that would make today feel handled, and do just that.
today.breather: Take ten minutes with nothing planned. It counts as a task.

area.kids: Pick one kid-related thing to sort out this week, not all of them.
area.money: Look at the whole month's money picture once, then stop.
area.work: Choose the one work thing that would take the most pressure off.
area.home: One household task that would make the space feel calmer.
area.relationship: Find a moment this week to talk when neither of you is exhausted.
area.health: One small thing for your own energy: sleep, food, a walk.
area.other: The other thing on your mind gets a slot this week, not today.

letGo.homePerfect: The house does not need to be tidy today.
letGo.moneyWhole: You do not have to solve the whole money situation today. One step is enough.
letGo.relationshipTalk: Big conversations can wait for a day with more energy.
letGo.kidsExtra: Extra activities, perfect meals, and screen-time guilt.
letGo.workExtra: Anything at work that is nice to do rather than actually due.
letGo.everythingElse: Everything not on today's list. It will still be there tomorrow.
letGo.onMind: Some of what is on your mind can rest until things calm down.

notes.movedForTime: Moved here because today's usable time is short.
notes.movedForFocus: Moved here so today stays at three things.
notes.fromYou: From what else is on your mind

safety.title: Before anything else
safety.body: Some of what you wrote sounds like more than a busy day. Parent Reset cannot help with that, but people can.
safety.emergency: If you or someone else is in immediate danger, contact your local emergency services.
safety.trustedPerson: Reach out to someone you trust and tell them how today really is.
safety.support: Crisis support lines exist in most countries and are free and confidential. Search for one in your country or ask your doctor.

pause.title: Breathe with me
pause.intro: No typing and nothing to decide. Pick one and follow the circle. This works with a child on your hip.
pause.note: Nothing from this is saved. It is just a minute that belongs to you.

settle.name: Settle
settle.body: In for four, out for six. The everyday one.

steady.name: Steady
steady.body: Four in, four held, four out, four still. For when your head is racing.

sleep.name: Wind down
sleep.body: Four, seven, eight. For lying in the dark at the end of a long day.

done.title: That's done.
done.body: Your body is a little slower than it was a minute ago. That is the whole trick, and it works even when nothing else has changed.
done.countToday: {count, plural, one {That is your first pause today.} other {That is # pauses today. Needing them is not a weakness.}}

evening.title: How was today?
evening.intro: Four things, all optional. Tap the weather and put the phone down if that is all you have left.

hard.label: What was hard?
hard.hint: Name it once, here, instead of carrying it into tomorrow.

kept.label: What is worth keeping?
kept.hint: Small counts. This is the part that comes back to you in a few weeks.
kept.placeholder: She took my hand crossing the road without being asked.

tomorrow.label: One thing for tomorrow
tomorrow.hint: Just one. It will be waiting on your home screen in the morning.

errors.tooLong: That is longer than this box holds. Shorten it a little.
errors.save: That did not save. Try once more.

storm.title: That was a storm.
storm.body: You got everyone to the end of it, and that was the job today. Tomorrow is a different day and you do not have to fix tonight.

stormKept.title: A storm, and you still found something.
stormKept.body: A hard day with one good moment in it is still a hard day. But you noticed the moment, and that is not nothing.

rainHard.title: Heavy going.
rainHard.body: You put it down in words instead of carrying it silently. For tonight, that is enough.

kept.title: You kept something.
kept.body: In a few weeks this will come back to you, long after you have forgotten it. That is exactly why it is worth writing.

heard.title: That's written down.
heard.body: It is out of your head and on the page, where nobody else will read it.

afterReset.title: You showed up twice today.
afterReset.body: A reset earlier and a close tonight. That is a whole day of looking after yourself, on a day that probably did not feel like it.

steady.title: You keep coming back.
steady.body: Closing the day is becoming a habit, and it is one of the quietest useful ones there is.

plain.title: Day closed.
plain.body: That is all it takes. Sleep well.

kept.title: What you've kept
kept.subtitle: {count, plural, one {One moment you decided was worth keeping.} other {# moments you decided were worth keeping.}}

empty.body: Nothing here yet. When you close a day, whatever you write under "worth keeping" lands here — and comes back to you weeks later, when you have forgotten it.

vent.title: Say it here
vent.intro: The thing you cannot say in the kitchen. Write it as badly as you like, then tear it up.
vent.label: What you want to say
vent.promise: Never saved, never sent, not even to this device.

gone.title: Gone.
gone.body: That is not stored anywhere. You said it, and now you are not the only one holding it in silence — because nobody is holding it at all.
